title: Crosshairs Appear to Have a Slight Transparent Background

judgment.rationale: The report gives useful settings and a clear visual symptom, but the crosshairs opacity value and a visual comparison are missing. Current upstream code defaults opacity to 75% and applies it to the root crosshairs visual, so the reported dimming cannot yet be distinguished from the configured opacity effect or verified as darkening outside the lines. Ask only for that targeted comparison; do not request generic logs or a new reproduction checklist.
judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge that the supplied 1 px width, 0 px border, and 200 px length are useful reproduction settings. Ask for the opacity value and a paired on/off screenshot after testing at 100% opacity; then decide whether the effect exceeds the crosshair strokes before proposing any code change.
evidence: The issue body specifies PowerToys 0.102.2933 and crosshair width 1 px, border 0 px, length 200 px; no opacity value or screenshot/video is attached.
The only discussion after the bot triage is the reporter saying they thought they had supplied the reproduction steps; no maintainer has asked the targeted opacity/comparison question yet.
Current upstream InclusiveCrosshairs.h sets the default opacity to 75%; InclusiveCrosshairs.cpp applies the configured opacity to the root visual and converts the percentage to a 0..1 value.
No matching fork issue, fork PR, or exact-title upstream duplicate was found. The similarly named Find My Mouse transparency issue concerns a different feature.

fix_assessment.rationale: No code fix can be assessed yet because the report does not establish that the visible effect is an anomalous overlay rather than the configured crosshairs opacity. The targeted visual comparison is needed before assigning a root cause or fix; no speculative implementation plan is proposed.

issue_context.summary: With Mouse Pointer Crosshairs set to 1 px width, 0 px border, and 200 px length, the reporter sees slight background darkening in the area around the crosshairs and expects no darkening beneath the square.
known_information: The current issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, Needs-Team-Response, and Product-Mouse Utilities.
The report specifies PowerToys v0.102.2933, auto-update installation, and the three crosshairs settings; it does not specify opacity.
The bot asked for reproduction detail, and the author replied that they thought the steps were already supplied; those steps do state the settings and symptom.
Current upstream code sets the crosshairs opacity default to 75% and applies the configured value to the root visual.
No attachment or related fork mirror/PR is present. The separate Find My Mouse transparency issue is not the same feature.
inferences: The reported dimming could be the configured opacity behavior, but the existing text does not establish whether the visible effect covers only the strokes or a larger region.
A paired visual comparison with opacity set to 100% can distinguish the reported overlay effect from the normal configured opacity without requiring a diagnostic archive.
issue_context.analysis: The reporter has already given a concrete reproduction configuration, so repeating the bot's generic request for steps would not help. The key missing variable is crosshairs opacity, whose current default is 75%, plus visual evidence that identifies the extent of the darkening. Request a matching enabled/disabled comparison at 100% opacity and avoid a code-fix proposal until the behavior is verified.
initial_investigation: Read the full live issue body and both comments; the author has not supplied a screenshot/video or opacity value.

Inspected current upstream InclusiveCrosshairs.h and InclusiveCrosshairs.cpp: default opacity is 75%, and the root visual receives the configured opacity. Source snapshots are privately retained and hashed in the receipt.
Reviewed relevant crosshairs UI tests; they set opacity explicitly but do not assert whether pixels outside the line strokes are dimmed.
Checked exact-title and transparency-related upstream issue searches, current fork issue/PR search, and existing canonical item path; no exact duplicate, fix PR, or fork trace found.
Reviewed related #15512 and confirmed it concerns Find My Mouse spotlight transparency, not Mouse Pointer Crosshairs.

information_gaps.information: The current Crosshairs opacity value and a paired visual sample showing the effect with crosshairs enabled and disabled at 100% opacity
information_gaps.why_needed: The current code defaults opacity to 75%; a paired comparison at 100% is needed to determine whether the reporter sees normal configured opacity or unexpected dimming outside the 1 px strokes.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: In PowerToys Settings > Mouse Utilities > Mouse Pointer Crosshairs, note the opacity value, set it to 100%, reproduce with the reported width/border/length, and attach a screenshot with crosshairs on plus a matching screenshot with them off.

comment.body: Thanks, the 1 px width, 0 px border, and 200 px length are useful reproduction steps. One detail is still needed to distinguish the configured opacity from unexpected background dimming: what opacity value is selected? Crosshairs currently defaults to 75%. Please set it to 100%, reproduce with the same settings, and attach one screenshot with crosshairs enabled plus a matching screenshot with them disabled. This visual comparison will show whether pixels outside the 1 px strokes are being darkened.
